## why (source)
pkg/image/platform.go backendPlatforms: the native backends return [darwin/arm64/v8] (+darwin/amd64 iff HostRosetta), VM returns linux/*,
every other backend value returns ErrNoPlatformMatch; PlatformPolicy.Override is checked against that same runnable set, so no
per-pod override can reach wasi/wasm32 today:
  266:func backendPlatforms(p PlatformPolicy) ([]Platform, error) {
  267-	switch p.Backend {
  268-	case runtimev1.SandboxBackend_SANDBOX_BACKEND_SEATBELT_INPROC,
  269-		runtimev1.SandboxBackend_SANDBOX_BACKEND_SEATBELT_EXEC,
  270-		runtimev1.SandboxBackend_SANDBOX_BACKEND_UIDJAIL:
  271-		out := []Platform{platDarwinARM64}
  272-		if p.HostRosetta {
  273-			out = append(out, platDarwinAMD64)
  274-		}
  275-		return out, nil
  276-	case runtimev1.SandboxBackend_SANDBOX_BACKEND_VM:
  277-		out := []Platform{platLinuxARM64}
  278-		if p.GuestRosetta {
  279-			out = append(out, platLinuxAMD64)
  280-		}
  281-		return out, nil
  282-	default:
  283-		return nil, fmt.Errorf("sandbox backend %v has no image platform candidates: %w", p.Backend, ErrNoPlatformMatch)
  284-	}
  285-}
  286-
  287-// containsPlatform reports whether want (already normalised) is in set (already
  288-// normalised).

## verdict
N/A: the precondition 'once the platform row exists' does not hold on this tree. What the Puller returns now, for both the
single-platform image and the index: 'no image manifest matches a runnable platform: want [darwin/arm64/v8], image provides
[wasi/wasm32]' (FAILURE_REASON_IMAGE_NO_PLATFORM_MATCH; kubectl shows ImagePullBackOff and an Event message truncated before the
platform list). The fetch and the index walk succeed and the refusal names the image's own platform: the pull stops at platform selection.
What R4 needs: a SANDBOX_BACKEND_WASM case in backendPlatforms returning wasi/wasm32 plus the explicit alias rows (wasi/wasm,
wasip1/wasm32, wasip2/wasm32), and UnpackPolicyFor(WASM) = SemanticsNative. Unmeasured here: whether unpack/materialize of a wasm layer then succeeds.
